about_the_game:
Hatch & Collect: Desktop Dino & Chill

Bring your desktop to life with adorable dinosaurs! Hatch and raise your own Dino companions in the background while you work or play. Watch as they roam around, collecting gems for you over time.

Hatch and collect a variety of unique dinosaurs, each with different spawn rates!
Let your Dino's gather gems while you focus on other tasks.

Move and resize them anywhere on your screen—perfect for multiple monitor setups!
Dinosaurs can get messy… so be sure to clean up after them!

Unlock new items, perks, and surprises using the gems your Dino's collect.

Customize your experience, grow your collection, and enjoy your very own desktop Dino adventure!

short_description: Hatch and collect adorable dinosaurs that roam your screen while you work or play! Watch them gather gems, unlock perks, and customize your setup. Move and resize them freely, even across multiple monitors. But be careful—these dinos can get messy, so don’t forget to clean up after them!
